samples.description: Annual Compustat firm-years in the target labels 1951–2001 with a uniquely selected adjacent prior fiscal-year record, stable historical primary HIID, a date-effective CCM link through exact LIID or a documented X-suffix dummy placeholder, one unambiguous CRSP PERMNO across actual report-date endpoints, currency-matched prior-date price, complete CRSP DSI-calendar daily return coverage over the actual interval, and separate within-year 1st/99th percentile trimming of EPS per prior-period price and Return. Actual prior/current DATADATEs, header and historical issue IDs, link route, expected/observed return sessions, and selected price-date evidence are retained.

assumptions: Use fiscal-year returns compounded from daily CRSP RET over (prior actual Compustat DATADATE, current actual DATADATE], and require every CRSP DSI expected trading session in that actual window, because the pooled annual fit's alternative window is unspecified.

Use EPSPX rebased by AJEX_(t-1)/AJEX_t to the prior-date share basis and the prior-date price: USD CRSP PRC for USD EPS, or Compustat PRCC_F only when the same historical-primary HIID security-price currency matches current EPS currency.
Trim outside the 1st and 99th percentiles of EPS/price and Return separately within fiscal year; retain percentile ties.
Estimate pooled OLS with conventional homoskedastic standard errors because estimator and inference are unspecified.

Match CRSP using the stable historical primary HIID and date-effective CCM LIID; permit a provider-documented X-suffix dummy LIID placeholder only over its recorded dates, coalescing overlapping or adjacent direct/placeholder segments only for the same GVKEY, HIID, and PERMNO; exclude ambiguous PERMNOs.
